This compound then exerts its effect on Neuropilin-2, indicating a possible pathway where Kazinol J indirectly influences Neuropilin-2 via Caspase-14 and its substrate. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, though the exact nature of the interaction between Kazinol J and Neuropilin-2 remains unclear. The observed scores suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction and functional role of Kazinol J in Neuropilin-2 regulation.
